content: HITL approval UX consensus for AI agents: 'Approval Queue' is the dominant pattern -- agent proposes action, pushes to queue, blocks until human decides. Rule of thumb: autonomy on reads, human gate on writes/irreversible/money/production/compliance actions. Best dashboards show the exact action + target + content (diff, recipient, command) with nothing hidden, offer Confirm/Cancel plus 'approve with edits' (draft+approve beats approve-then-fix). Three named sub-patterns: Approval (stop before high-risk action), Intervention (override mid-execution), Clarification (agent asks when confidence low).
